offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures research reagents and analytical instruments for biopharmaceutical companies and research laboratories. It also supplies spatial biology assays and molecular diagnostic kits and controls to research and clinical laboratories.

primary_products.value: recombinant proteins; antibodies and immunoassay kits; protein analysis instruments and consumables; spatial biology instruments and assays; molecular diagnostic kits and controls

primary_services.value: custom reagent development and manufacturing; custom assay development; instrument maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Biopharmaceutical companies, universities, clinical laboratories and diagnostic manufacturers; B2G: Government research laboratories and public health agencies

end_markets.value: life science research; biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing; cell and gene therapy; clinical diagnostics

revenue_model.value: product sales: Reagents, instruments, consumables, diagnostic kits and controls; project or contract: Custom assay development and reagent manufacturing; service fees: Instrument maintenance and repair
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Uses biological materials and instrument components to make reagents, instruments and kits for research and clinical laboratories; component supplier: Supplies proteins, antibodies and controls as inputs for biopharmaceutical and diagnostic manufacturers; service provider: Develops custom reagents and assays to customer specifications and services laboratory instruments
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Research reagents, protein analysis instruments, spatial biology tools and molecular diagnostics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving biopharmaceutical, academic and clinical laboratory accounts; online: Company e-commerce catalogs for reagents and laboratory supplies; distributors / dealers: Laboratory supply distributors in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Certain clinical diagnostic kits require FDA clearance or authorization and compliance with applicable in vitro diagnostic rules

notes: The current scope of its clinical diagnostics portfolio is uncertain.
